facts.fact: Loi n° 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 on the protection of personal data was adopted by the National Assembly and promulgated, with art. 95 giving two years for State and public-service processing and one year for all other processing to comply.
facts.system: Loi n° 2019-014 relative a la protection des donnees a caractere personnel

facts.fact: Art. 55 of the law creates a national authority, the IPDCP, whose president the President of the Republic appoints by decree from its steering committee (art. 58); the document does not show it constituted.
facts.system: Instance de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (IPDCP)
